"text": "Maître Andry leva les yeux, parut mesurer un instant la hauteur du pilier, la pesanteur du drôle, multiplia mentalement cette pesanteur par le carré de la vitesse, et se tut.", "sha256": "61b75624ad66e742fc349a24d66ab7b6e1e6670b72d62a50307cdcdf5e6537de", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [87], "source_xml_sha256": "855262174bba0494bc04155e3c78372191913ed1ef300808fbe0da0072456fe7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0053", "text": "Jehan, maître du champ de bataille, poursuivit avec triomphe:", "sha256": "057ed58eb3c2b1c92fb30f83adf8c900dc9e94b90301f1470d8431f595b78c15", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [88], "source_xml_sha256": "ff84cbeec7b50a3a3342ddc0fb456785959f8dd934805f9f1f8e4cd277127f33", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0054", "text": "«C'est que je le ferais, quoique je sois frère d'un archidiacre!", "sha256": "fb6e7a506389b6fcd42d2bc98c04299524f474ec6cff841b7c24e6751ca6b1c9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [89], "source_xml_sha256": "7e74059054093bbadbdd0b4d1f16fdb1f2caa226f1f6e02a17c410895696d4ea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0055", "text": "—Beaux sires, que nos gens de l'Université! n'avoir seulement pas fait respecter nos privilèges dans un jour comme celui-ci! Enfin, il y a mai et feu de joie à la Ville; mystère, pape des fous et ambassadeurs flamands à la Cité; et à l'Université, rien!", "sha256": "fe19511aedb32a4b6434be4d4aaabd54359438d169fb02a055816f37567470d8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [90], "source_xml_sha256": "ccc679a0d5695e004eaa3009c6bf043b7cdb9220e8697e76d821956a91ede076", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0056", "text": "—Cependant la place Maubert est assez grande! reprit un des clercs cantonnés sur la table de la fenêtre.", "sha256": "df4231c4a826cbdd577a4a65b2f7e39383c665fa641a50bd88f2b171c428a9ff", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [91], "source_xml_sha256": "61e32f90ff0bf406efc55fe67bb54f955b67bed43e3e1b73821a09deb30f95b8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0057", "text": "—À bas le recteur, les électeurs et les procureurs! cria Joannes.", "sha256": "59f7647c2ce1a12e4132074e695bcb9cfc38757526a17dcaddb9e64f606f3b44", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [92], "source_xml_sha256": "47fe46df6ee79dbce362ff8a80f90748b3c62ba85deec269cec59aef04e2b22c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0058", "text": "—Il faudra faire, un feu de joie ce soir dans le Champ-Gaillard, poursuivit l'autre, avec les livres de maître Andry.", "sha256": "a1aa7e66752f4f617ea8e80a6f5496210a08a4e392ac21a15c13e65f14d35ba6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [93], "source_xml_sha256": "c057a47fceb9a5c75e257f42a831e65420713464c3a458fba887d39826458aa2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0059", "text": "—Et les pupitres des scribes! dit son voisin.", "sha256": "6a929e3229327ff2ce204175ce8a96d981c7bb14dc619ae063610c6254a728e6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [94], "source_xml_sha256": "5175645ced0c46c76854ef929e09a2085f6993bc4467c5c3abe4fb9d6d1aebce", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0060", "text": "—Et les verges des bedeaux!", "sha256": "8847d7d5502e3a39955069c196d0918385ab33f49129ac335584ae4ea2813906", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [95], "source_xml_sha256": "18658577e9fa65e0067795cf011639ad796b723ff195a5c3f4fc81f194109bea", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0061", "text": "—Et les crachoirs des doyens!", "sha256": "d425787225719da95286ee124b3a677ace5b635e09186622e7d51a28bf59a59c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [96], "source_xml_sha256": "2f61f88ab3a72990c8e940629fc1eb25218ab3e282b0cab2c9598619283b9db2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0062", "text": "—Et les buffets des procureurs!", "sha256": "9ff33b24f70aeb1c8178c8eb4c2a55135175a51674faa284142509d7b08fb6ef", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [97], "source_xml_sha256": "a0df575dd71dad57da71748ea1cf14842822ed4e83a74a76fc604dc9a9357943", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0063", "text": "—Et les huches des électeurs!", "sha256": "364f3a03b577aef2422f239c6ec6df036c94a53250cbd22fd39cdecf3727ae0e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [98], "source_xml_sha256": "075de1dbbd58aa08e35d56e4cb01c0ca2ccec2a4477c70da6d76cc516b00c840", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0064", "text": "—Et les escabeaux du recteur!", "sha256": "23720414655aaefcc6fce84bf3e326d6c6378a8c5ff4a6a0d2b12fbd71a02190", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [99], "source_xml_sha256": "d223ac290ea1994fcd56bb58b72fd42663b8dd9b228197795f0e6e3a1d4a6602", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0065", "text": "—À bas! reprit le petit Jehan en faux-bourdon; à bas maître Andry, les bedeaux et les scribes; les théologiens, les médecins et les décrétistes; les procureurs, les électeurs et le recteur!", "sha256": "5f65881f768ab66b6b7a0d172cb12636a4b5a0faf8ebd3200455bf7d41db2060", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [100], "source_xml_sha256": "408670afcb4fb8289330ec91e73c66762a4e774bf4cdc8f8ed3b7469a80ee8a0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0066", "text": "—C'est donc la fin du monde! murmura maître Andry en se bouchant les oreilles.", "sha256": "15d89352e6ca6b21073597bfa170288d2ea94624cc1d0837de34deb51f6cab3d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [101], "source_xml_sha256": "53baf4e3b85b1dcba70540b523f0937ffbbe44409b6b25e78a8fb59e3e34b3da", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0067", "text": "—À propos, le recteur! le voici qui passe dans la place», cria un de ceux de la fenêtre.", "sha256": "8e0d72301b936a3dfe6d6b0b1d5336cd2b4cc717a5d7f19bd6ee8f63834aaf5c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [102], "source_xml_sha256": "d048540449dca1258b9c6d8415646bc0d7af96f4e0ee93d8c824d57520c319a7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0068", "text": "Ce fut à qui se retournerait vers la place.", "sha256": "66ad538b5de6ac7eac097e5ee5217dc897fa99a9b05317ae6b77130a9edaae4b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [103], "source_xml_sha256": "af9cd1cdca79aec15141560f1a2c143f6183a5db6114439e238862c26ceb6c16", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0069", "text": "«Est-ce que c'est vraiment notre vénérable recteur maître Thibaut? demanda Jehan Frollo du Moulin, qui, s'étant accroché à un pilier de l'intérieur, ne pouvait voir ce qui se passait au dehors.", "sha256": "0eb462fc85de20590fac1f63c1f23cbad2fe67d01f6bcda885bf6ac01d72e90d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [104], "source_xml_sha256": "6f921c10d46a1b3e4fa3fa9e2b6d746c97c6ecac3de25b6f449129aa6efc302a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0070", "text": "—Oui, oui, répondirent tous les autres, c'est lui, c'est bien lui, maître Thibaut le recteur.»", "sha256": "d8ae8c394c47dbe2ed77db234c796d65bcf47636155d0b08c789ee69fb3acd77", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [105], "source_xml_sha256": "c236e2186defc19b5c943acadfb9dc8ababc066d21042713c2538700456e99ec", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0071", "text": "C'était en effet le recteur et tous les dignitaires de l'Université qui se rendaient processionnellement au-devant de l'ambassade et traversaient en ce moment la place du Palais. Les écoliers, pressés à la fenêtre, les accueillirent au passage avec des sarcasmes et des applaudissements ironiques. Le recteur, qui marchait en tête de sa compagnie, essuya la première bordée; elle fut rude.", "sha256": "33efcf82f8ff0611bf1729046c74374af38e4b4b0b8c578925723bf6c58ac74e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [106], "source_xml_sha256": "f69c622794c20ff880383c2ab703ee8b44f56d991ec6f66c022ca0cc0c7df573", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0072", "text": "«Bonjour, monsieur le recteur! Holàhée! bonjour donc!", "sha256": "da4c3fc93bfe3d8990bad704d247baeb72ef0c63f37994121d00105fa7fa1ebf", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [107], "source_xml_sha256": "60d248188ab2ed4080c2bceea3402661445ebd1ef0f93e4cb5ebd2daa7e457f2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0073", "text": "—Comment fait-il pour être ici, le vieux joueur? Il a donc quitté ses dés?", "sha256": "86e472baa4c37f1cd1668812e613f8445268c23adebb3da26f0fe908f8745fef", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [108], "source_xml_sha256": "e7f72835f560c4c721c2053f20f3f61dd931848f7a823ab472b9b18d544c59e4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0074", "text": "—Comme il trotte sur sa mule! elle a les oreilles moins longues que lui.", "sha256": "9e4f5ebf8bb11bfafb89102855850a523c327c5a45fcf9598c3e2e611a8a38e4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [109], "source_xml_sha256": "8c813c97570c09b21428f70fb861f9d2b3d6f9ae5f0242ea1544aaff26598316", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0075", "text": "—Holàhée! bonjour, monsieur le recteur Thibaut! [[I]]Tybalde aleator[[/I]][[N4]]! vieil imbécile! vieux joueur!", "sha256": "541dbf20064acf3f217357ffd89a01c1783b1c32911759a1e95cd501340168b0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [110], "source_xml_sha256": "f99f5d00ea96ff562edaaf889a32993292a97550ad77812040e7dbab725f4f83", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N4]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0076", "text": "—Dieu vous garde! avez-vous fait souvent double-six cette nuit?", "sha256": "58bcf1150dcf7a2b867eb06b3de0034a6e9bd1db8ca46e76b8da64e0b75b2136", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [111], "source_xml_sha256": "188b61e01e5b9d9d77583406b86c00388740753523adaa2c1952d94c0f7bdcf7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0077", "text": "—Oh! la caduque figure, plombée, tirée et battue pour l'amour du jeu et des dés!", "sha256": "ddb4df54b540d66304f6177e4e02cc206a6ab7a1726e89643c17da555b14a341", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [112], "source_xml_sha256": "7b3614eea4a9d8d0f7f57bbedca29681e63cc61de2a0a1b482896a3ad8c39a14", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0078", "text": "—Où allez-vous comme cela, [[I]]Tybalde ad dados[[/I]][[N5]], tournant le dos à l'Université et trottant vers la Ville?", "sha256": "cd6c7dcc17f382ef622892b256e9d578c8ee7c459babfa7602305ac12c9a1ca4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [113], "source_xml_sha256": "43c56317b317e25f7ca906061ceb27115e3ac18c59d79f9ac53266293ef0c371", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N5]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0079", "text": "—Il va sans doute chercher un logis rue Thibautodé», cria Jehan du Moulin.", "sha256": "48092fc5b82057aa60a6a240d4ebd35dd39a2df456ea7483743768ecc5a5ce71", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [114], "source_xml_sha256": "83aec77e1aba23ad80af5e569245d3e6574ff9002f96580f312484aa9168a5ca", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0080", "text": "Toute la bande répéta le quolibet avec une voix de tonnerre et des battements de mains furieux.", "sha256": "6d494a2b7470493e67efa97e9c7abe84f949f85f35a944178a56dc024faa8323", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [115], "source_xml_sha256": "3a4b77005494730fb92d750657fcca6902847dcb99c488e4bed5f63fdd815f46", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0081", "text": "«Vous allez chercher logis rue Thibautodé, n'est-ce pas, monsieur le recteur, joueur de la partie du diable?»", "sha256": "98eff60b769ecd46e3031db460ec0b4a4dd8d95d8d981d02e1bef9b9ef97333d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [116], "source_xml_sha256": "8204367f22a4600f995a6ec0dc36ac6a815b5975f43aba0cfde32ed0e8d1d5fd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0082", "text": "Puis ce fut le tour des autres dignitaires.", "sha256": "16d8b0f22eccd3593dee157acf7f6c20a51bd1fbb562103e54f54a768769b442", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [117], "source_xml_sha256": "663988f491f30deae9d7a8da170aff9f046aef4457f3b5ef4a67dfb370422a35", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u003-b0083", "text": "«À bas les bedeaux! à bas les massiers!", "sha256": "65edc860337377496efc53bb8cba2b90ca87ca2c42a644db83dddec2d916bc8a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [118], "source_xml_sha256":
